kami.description: Phase 3 reference manifest — drives example.com via DOM. No real backend; the kami exists purely to exercise the browser-only L1 emitter (ADR-2605211900 D4 row c). A future driver (mcp__claude-in-chrome or sandboxed Playwright pod) replays the step sequence.

ops.name: readHeading
ops.summary: Read the H1 heading from example.com
ops.description: Navigates to the kami's base URL, waits for the H1 to render, and extracts its textContent. Exists as the minimum L1 demonstration for browser-only mode.

ops.name: searchTerm
ops.summary: Fill a hypothetical search input on the portal and read results
ops.description: Hypothetical flow exercising fill + click + scroll + multi-extract — the page itself does NOT have a real search box, but the kami manifest is shaped this way to validate the L1 emitter's required-input derivation.
